scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');fs.copyFileSync('public/manuale-utente.html','dist/manuale-utente.html');fs.copyFileSync('public/manuale-utente.html','dist/manuale-utente');fs.copyFileSync('public/_headers','dist/_headers');fs.copyFileSync('public/welcome-kit-renu.pdf','dist/welcome-kit-renu.pdf');fs.mkdirSync('dist/audio',{recursive:true});['parlano-gli-occhi.mp3','sguardi-di-renu.mp3'].forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync('public/audio/'+f,'dist/audio/'+f));const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('dist/_routes.json','utf8'));['/manuale-utente.html','/manuale-utente','/welcome-kit-renu.pdf','/audio/parlano-gli-occhi.mp3','/audio/sguardi-di-renu.mp3'].forEach(p=>{if(!r.exclude.includes(p))r.exclude.push(p)});fs.writeFileSync('dist/_routes.json',JSON.stringify(r));console.log('✓ audio, PDF e _headers copiati in dist/')"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
